name: 铱云供应链
description: Manage IRCloud Easy Order via CLI.
description_zh: 通过自然语言管理铱云供应链：支持订单全链路操作，以及客户、商品、仓库库存、员工组织、资金账户、数据导出、经营统计和预警明细的查询分析。
description_en: Manage 77ircloud Supply Chain using natural language: supports full-lifecycle order operations, as well as query and analysis for customers, products, warehouse inventory, employee organization, financial accounts, data export, business statistics, and warning details.
examples_zh: 查询今天待发货的订单
创建一个新的销售订单，客户为上海星辰贸易有限公司
查看商品精品咖啡的库存
新增一个商品，名称为精品咖啡，售价 99 元
查看客户上海星辰贸易有限公司的订单记录
统计本月销售额前十的商品
examples_en: Create a new sales order for customer Shanghai Xingchen Trading Co., Ltd.
Check the inventory for the product Premium Coffee
Create a new product named Premium Coffee priced at CNY 99
Show the order history for customer Shanghai Xingchen Trading Co., Ltd.
Show the top 10 products by sales revenue this month
